notes.title: LiveOnIdol has been released !!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38250904/12390bb6b7387df435ee99c9de77814373cdad5e.png[/img]






It's a VR-only game called Live On Idol. It will be officially released on July 21st.


LiveOnIdol VR is a casual adventure game using VR controllers.


We're going to show Jenny, the main character of a beautiful girl, to a VR controller camera in various 

places in her particular costume.


It is a game that completes the photo book called LiveOnIdol by taking pictures.
